title: Redacting Personal Data: A Speed and Accuracy Comparison of Regex, Presidio and Hybrid Designs
abstract: arXiv:2611.07633v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many enterprise projects now pass free text to large language models (LLMs), and that text often contains personally identifiable information (PII) such as names, phone numbers, email addresses, home addresses and dates of birth. Once a prompt is sent, this data is copied into provider systems, application logs and observability traces. Redacting PII before the call is an obvious control, yet teams seldom have numbers on what it costs in latency or what it lets through. This paper compares four redaction designs that any LLM pipeline can adopt: a pure regular-expression (regex) redactor, Microsoft Presidio running on a spaCy model, a hybrid in which Presidio finds only person names while regex handles structured identifiers, and a fast hybrid that calls spaCy's named-entity component directly. translated_title: 个人数据脱敏：正则表达式、Presidio与混合设计在速度和准确性上的比较
translated_abstract: 许多企业项目现在将自由文本传递给大型语言模型（LLM），而这些文本通常包含个人身份信息（PII），例如姓名、电话号码、电子邮箱地址、家庭住址和出生日期。一旦提示词被发送出去，这些数据就会被复制到服务提供商的系统、应用程序日志和可观测性追踪记录中。在调用之前对PII进行脱敏是一种显而易见的控制措施，但团队往往缺乏关于这一措施在延迟上付出多少代价、又会漏掉哪些数据的量化数据。本文比较了任何LLM处理管道都可以采用的四种脱敏设计：纯正则表达式脱敏器、运行在spaCy模型之上的Microsoft Presidio、由Presidio仅识别人名而正则表达式处理结构化标识符的混合设计，以及直接调用spaCy命名实体组件的快速混合设计。这四种设计均共享一个已知实体规则（即移除系统已知正在处理的那个人），并采用一致的占位符方案，从而……
tldr: 本文系统比较了四种可用于LLM管道的PII脱敏设计方案（纯正则、Presidio、以及两种混合设计）在速度与准确性上的表现差异。
en_tdlr: This paper compares four PII redaction designs for LLM pipelines—regex-only, Microsoft Presidio, and two hybrid approaches—in terms of their speed and accuracy trade-offs.
